name: Whelm

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book. Artifact random properties use the game's condensed tables (deviations.md).

powers.name: Shock Wave
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): strike the ground: creatures within 60 ft make a DC 15 Con save or are Stunned for 1 minute.

summary: +3 warhammer that returns when thrown, stuns those it hits on a throw, and shakes the ground once a day.
text: Whelm is a powerful warhammer forged by dwarves and lost in the dungeon of White Plume Mountain. You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the Thrown property with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. When you hit with a ranged attack using it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn; the hammer then flies back to your hand. Once per dawn you can take a Magic action to strike the ground and send out a shock wave: each creature of your choice within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or is Stunned for 1 minute. It is sentient (Intelligence 15, Wisdom 12, Charisma 15) and hates giants and goblinoids.
